To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the non-polio human enterovirus serotype 74, 87 and 80 were isolated for the first time from AFP surveillance in China.
three novel HEVs were isolated from AFP cases in Shandog Province, China.
three non-polio enteric viruses were identified in the Shandong Province in 2011, and these strains were genetically distant from the prototype strains.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the molecular characterization of EV74, EV87 and EV80 isolated in Shand Dong province.
the identification and molecular characterization of EV74, EV 80, and EV87 in China.
the identification of EV74, EV87, and EV80 strains, and will provide a reference for future studies.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the molecular typing method based upon VP1 sequence analysis is an efficient method for typing NPEV, and it is important for epidemiology and public health to identify new types of NPEV.
the EV74 and EV80 strains identified in this study have not been isolated in China before.
these three serotypes were not the predominant viruses in AFP surveillance, and further studies are required to investigate the epidemiological characteristics of these three serotypes.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the molecular typing method is effective for the identification and molecular characterization of HEVs.
the application of molecular method could be a good way to identify HEV serotypes and monitor the circulation of HEV in the community.
the VP1 sequences analysis of NPEV strains isolated in China is of great significance for the epidemiological surveillance of enteroviruses and the study of their evolution.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the molecular typing method based VP1 sequence is an effective way to identify HEV.
EV74, EV 80 and EV87 should be taken into account for surveillance of non-polio enteroviurses in mainland China.
the molecular typing method is a useful tool for the surveillance of NPEV.
